03 The shift Same team · different decisions

What changes the day
INAYA goes live.

Three moments every procurement team lives through. How they go today — and how they go on day one with INAYA.

01 Monday · 9:00 AM

The CFO asks for Q3 exposure on cocoa.

Today

You email Mark for the latest ICIS PDF. Pull the supplier portal CSV. Build an exposure model in Excel from scratch. Send a number on Wednesday with a footnote — "subject to material revision."

With INAYA

You ask Lisa in Teams. Thirty seconds: 4,200t open, $42.6M forward exposure, bull/base/bear scenarios with confidence bands. Forwarded to the CFO with the model citation attached.

02 Thursday · fixing committee

4,200t to decide. Procurement, Finance and Risk in one room.

Today

You walk in with last quarter's spreadsheet and an ICIS chart. Procurement and Finance argue about the baseline. The decision gets pushed a week — and the price moves anyway.

With INAYA

Three scenarios on screen — hold, partial lock, full lock — each with quantified margin impact and a probability. The committee picks one. Decision recorded with timestamps, model version and assumptions.

03 Six months later

The auditor asks: "Why did you fix at $4,200 in March?"

Today

You dig through email threads. The memo is somewhere in OneDrive. You can't reconstruct the assumptions. The margin variance gets flagged as "judgment" and you spend a week explaining it.

With INAYA

You open the decision record. Model version, market state at the time, scenarios considered, the rationale, who signed off. The auditor's question closes in ten minutes.
